description: Add or remove contacts from a contact group. Use this to manage which contacts belong to a group/label. This is the only way to change group membership - the People API does not support editing it via contact_update.

resourceName.description: The resource name of the contact group (e.g., "contactGroups/1234")

resourceNamesToAdd.description: Resource names of contacts to add to the group (e.g., "people/c12345")

resourceNamesToRemove.description: Resource names of contacts to remove from the group (e.g., "people/c12345")

name: contact_group_members_modify
title: Modify contact group members
